label: M0saic Brand Marks
description: Renders any m0saic brand mark — the M (as rects or bitmap), the m0 logotype, or the m0saic pattern — with an animated reveal, each at its official dictionary resolution. Default 'm-33' is the fast rect M; 'composite' (bitmap + rects blend) is the deliberate heavy render. Supersedes the earlier brand-logo templates.

size.label: Brand entry
size.description: m-33 (default): the fast rect M at its official 544² canvas. composite: m-33_bitmap base + rect M overlaid with an animated blend — the HEAVY render (minutes, not seconds). Also: m0 (logotype, 384×512), m0saic-pattern (4354×2016), m-33_bitmap.

animation.label: Animation
animation.description: How the mark moves: loading_ui_v2 (a soft pulse with a shimmer sweep), logo_loop (reveal in, hold, reveal out), progress_fill (fills 0 → 100%), loading_shimmer (a sweeping band).

blendInSec.label: Blend-in (s)
blendInSec.description: Composite only: seconds the rect M takes to fade in over the bitmap (and back out).

blendDelaySec.label: Blend delay (s)
blendDelaySec.description: Composite only: seconds the rect M waits before each fade.

blendFeather.label: Blend feather
blendFeather.description: Composite only: a small lift on the rect M's fade so it never starts fully clear.

feather.label: Feather
feather.description: Softens the edge of the fill, shimmer or reveal as it crosses a tile (0 = hard edge).

shimmerSec.label: Shimmer sweep (s)
shimmerSec.description: Seconds for one shimmer sweep across the mark.

shimmerWidth.label: Shimmer width
shimmerWidth.description: Width of the shimmer band, as a fraction of the mark (0–1).

progress.label: Progress
progress.description: Progress fill: how much of the mark is filled (0–1). Clear it to animate the fill instead.

progressSec.label: Progress duration (s)
progressSec.description: Progress fill: seconds for the animated fill, when Progress is not set.

oneShot.label: Play once
oneShot.description: Progress fill: play the animated fill once instead of looping.

rankSet.label: Reveal order
rankSet.description: Reveal order over the mark's tiles: diag (top-left → bottom-right), cascade (row-by-row), radial (center → edges).

loopSec.label: Loop length (s)
loopSec.description: Logo loop: seconds for one reveal-in, hold, reveal-out cycle.

inEnd.label: Reveal-in end
inEnd.description: Logo loop: fraction of the loop where the reveal-in finishes.

outStart.label: Reveal-out start
outStart.description: Logo loop: fraction of the loop where the reveal-out begins.

startDelay.label: Start hold
startDelay.description: Logo loop: fraction of the loop held empty before the reveal starts.

endDelay.label: End hold
endDelay.description: Logo loop: fraction of the loop held empty after the reveal-out.

easing.label: Easing
easing.description: Logo loop: linear, or smoothstep for a calm ease in and out.
